tests.name: I2C3
tests.wiring: Dedicated P7: SCL to P7.3/PA8, SDA to P7.2/PH8 and common ground. The fixture alone uses 0x42; onboard EEPROM 0x51 stays in normal I2C mode. Power pins remain disconnected.
tests.criterion: Fresh CRC-protected requests and transformed responses, including repeated START, independently verified on both USB endpoints.

tests.name: GPS2 · I2C
tests.path: PixNova I2C2 PF1/PF0 ↔ P3.3/P3.2 · Probe I2C4 PF14/PF15
tests.wiring: SCL to P3.3, SDA to P3.2 and common ground. The flight-controller bus is I2C2; the fixture bus is I2C4. Keep the onboard ICP-20100 at 0x63. The simulator alone uses 0x42.
tests.criterion: Fresh requests and CRC-protected responses through the external connector, independently reported by both boards.

tests.name: DSM/SBUS · SBUS
tests.path: Probe UART8 PE1 / P3.4 → jumper → RC SBUS input · PX4IO readback
tests.wiring: Disconnect the P3.4 GPS2 UART signal from PixNova before using it as a transmitter. Jumper test-board P3.4 to the flight-controller SBUS input signal, through the matching P4 signal if desired. P4.2/3 are PG13/PG12 and remain inputs. Connect common ground; leave connector power pins disconnected. No actuators attached.
tests.criterion: 100000 baud, inverted 8E2. PX4IO must report the selected protocol, seven matching channels, advancing frame count and no failsafe or armed outputs.

tests.name: DSM/SBUS · DSM
tests.path: Probe UART8 PE1 / P3.4 → jumper → RC DSM input · PX4IO readback
tests.wiring: Disconnect the P3.4 GPS2 UART signal from PixNova. Jumper test-board P3.4 to the flight-controller DSM input signal and connect common ground. Leave power pins disconnected. P4 cannot send hardware UART directly. No actuators attached.
tests.criterion: 115200 baud, 8N1, DSMX 11-bit frames. PX4IO must decode the selected protocol and seven matching channels with advancing frame count.

tests.name: CAN1 ↔ CAN2
tests.path: PixNova CAN1 H/L ↔ PixNova CAN2 H/L · 500 kbit/s
tests.wiring: Disconnect both CAN connectors from the test-board MCU headers. Connect flight-controller CAN1 H to CAN2 H, L to L and common ground. Verify correct bus termination for the isolated two-node bench bus. Do not connect CAN power pins. No internal or socket local loopback is accepted.
tests.criterion: At least 20 fresh, token/sequence-checked frames in each direction on distinct controllers, with no CAN error frames or receive timeouts.

tests.name: Ethernet ↔ PC
tests.wiring: Disconnect ETH from fixture P2. Use the correct PixNova Ethernet adapter and a real PC Ethernet interface. Configure that isolated PC interface to 192.168.77.1/24 yourself. This application does not change PC network settings. Allow its UDP traffic through the interface firewall. USB remains connected for control.
tests.criterion: Physical PHY link plus fresh bidirectional, token/sequence/CRC-checked UDP request/response packets. Both the PC and flight controller must verify them.

tests.name: GPS1 · I2C
tests.path: PixNova I2C1 PB8/PB9 ↔ P19.7 PH3 / P19.6 PH4
tests.wiring: GPIO slave at 10 kHz; SCL to P19.7/PH3, SDA to P19.6/PH4. This follows the measured cable path. The two signals are never frequency outputs. The simulator alone uses address 0x42. Connect common ground.
tests.criterion: Address ACK, complete write and repeated-START read, fresh run token/sequence and CRC validation on both boards.

tests.name: POWER1 · I2C
tests.path: PixNova I2C1 PB8/PB9 ↔ P5.3 PB8 / P5.4 PB9
tests.wiring: SCL to P5.3/PB8, SDA to P5.4/PB9. Signal pins and common ground only; leave both POWER1 supply pins disconnected. The simulator alone uses address 0x42. Connect common ground.
tests.criterion: Address ACK, complete write and repeated-START read, fresh run token/sequence and CRC validation on both boards.

tests.name: POWER2 · I2C
tests.path: PixNova I2C2 PF1/PF0 ↔ P6.3 PF1 / P6.4 PF0
tests.wiring: SCL to P6.3/PF1, SDA to P6.4/PF0. Signal pins and common ground only; leave both POWER2 supply pins disconnected. Onboard ICP-20100 at 0x63 remains in normal I2C mode. The simulator alone uses address 0x42. Connect common ground.
tests.criterion: Address ACK, complete write and repeated-START read, fresh run token/sequence and CRC validation on both boards.

tests.name: UART4/I2C3 · I2C
tests.path: PixNova I2C3 PA8/PH8 ↔ P17.4 PG1 / P17.3 PG2
tests.wiring: GPIO slave at 10 kHz: SCL to P17.4/PG1, SDA to P17.3/PG2. Onboard EEPROM 0x51 remains in normal I2C mode. The simulator alone uses address 0x42. Connect common ground.
tests.criterion: Address ACK, complete write and repeated-START read, fresh run token/sequence and CRC validation on both boards.

tests.name: ADC6V6 · 0 V
tests.path: Probe PF13 / P10.7 -> PixNova ADC6V6 divider -> PC2_C / ADC1 IN12
tests.wiring: Connect the flight-controller ADC6V6 interface to fixture ADIO P10.7/PF13 and common ground. Both boards use USB power. The source ADC pin remains an input.
tests.criterion: Fixture drives 0 V with verified GPIO readback. Flight-controller ADC must measure 0–0.1 V for three fresh report windows.

tests.name: ADC6V6 · 3.3 V
tests.path: Probe PF13 / P10.7 -> PixNova ADC6V6 divider -> PC2_C / ADC1 IN12
tests.wiring: Connect the flight-controller ADC6V6 interface to fixture ADIO P10.7/PF13 and common ground. Both boards use USB power. The source ADC pin remains an input.
tests.criterion: Fixture drives 3.3 V with verified GPIO readback. Flight-controller ADC must measure 1.5–1.8 V for three fresh report windows.
